author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಕ್ಷಕನು ತಾನುಳಿಯೆ ಶಕ್ರನನು ಸೆಳೆದಂತೆ
ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಶತ್ರುಗಳು ನಿನನೆಳೆಯಬಹುದು
ತಕ್ಷಣವೆ ಗೋಮುಖದ ಶತ್ರುನಡೆಯರಿಯುತಿರೆ
ಶಿಕ್ಷೆತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ ನಡೆವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As Takṣaka, to save himself, dragged in Indra,
enemies may drag you in to protect themselves;
if you see through the cow-faced enemy’s ways at once,
you will walk free of punishment, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: In the Mahābhārata, the serpent Takṣaka sheltered with Indra, and Janamejaya’s sacrifice nearly pulled Indra into the fire with him. People with innocent faces may drag us into their troubles to save themselves; recognise them early.
